new_slugs.name: Gaya confederacy
new_slugs.why: split from Byeonhan (Cliopatria row -91..566 is the Byeonhan confederacy to 300 and the Gaya confederacy 301..562)

gaps.what: End year: the page says Goguryeo annexed Ye in the 'early 5th-century' (dossier 401, confidence 1; Cliopatria 391/392); a small southern part to Silla has no year or place; Goguryeo's vassalage of the Ye (Taejo, reign 53-146) is undated
Ledger has only the 82 BCE independence and the end; the AD 40/60 raids and the Taejo subjugation are in wars only
End year of Mahan (346 is a bridge among 1st century, late 3rd, 4th, 5th and 6th century statements) and the drawn shape overstates the confederacy once Baekje is a kingdom (234-286)
End year 377 is a bridge ('4th century CE'); the Jinhan shape contains Silla/Saro from the start although Silla is a distinct polity by the 2nd century
Byeonhan/Gaya boundary 300/301 is a bridge between 42 CE, 2nd-3rd century, c. 209, late 3rd century and 4th century
Extent, capital and end year are not on the Jin page; the east-coast cut is certain only from 129 BCE
No area or boundary on either page; the realm before 194 BCE (Gija Joseon, Yan war c. 300 BCE) is outside the dossier
Takgitan Gaya (529) has no place on the page; the 391-412 Goguryeo pressure contradicts 532/562; no contest events

counterparts_needing_dossiers.name: Lelang Commandery (and the Four Commanderies of Han: Lelang, Lintun, Zhenfan, Xuantu; Canghai)

problems: gaya was written here as a split of the Byeonhan row (cliopatria_names ['Byeonhan']); jk-02-x, whose scope names Gaya, should not write it. byeonhan and gaya each leave two or one Cliopatria shapes of the Byeonhan row without a verdict on purpose (validator warnings).

dongye ends at 401 (confidence 1, page: 'early 5th-century') against Cliopatria's 391 and a Goguryeo shape from 392 that already contains the Ye land (+31,200 km2): the goguryeo dossier must date its gain of the Ye consistently, or the reviewer should shorten keyframe dongye_392.
dongye starts at 82 BCE, not 91: -91..-83 is Han's Lintun Commandery, for which no Cliopatria row or dossier exists (see counterparts_needing_dossiers).
korean-jin: Cliopatria's shape equals Mahan + Byeonhan + Jinhan + Dongye in area (112,814 vs 112,616 km2); both keyframes remove the Ye coast.
mahan and jinhan: Baekje (347) and Silla (378) repeat their shapes exactly, so the Baekje and Silla dossiers decide how much of Mahan/Jinhan the earlier Baekje/Silla statelets already held.
Cliopatria's Wikipedia field 'Dongye' is a disambiguation page; identity.wikipedia is 'Eastern Ye'. gojoseon shares Q28405 with joseon (1395-1897): different states.

Page budget: mahan, byeonhan and jinhan used 3 pages each against 1-2 (the extra page is the neighbour's article that dates the end); 18 distinct pages in all, 28 source entries over seven dossiers; no page failed to load.

Most boundary years (start and end of the Samhan, Jin, Mahan end, Jinhan end, Byeonhan/Gaya split, Dongye end) are confidence 1 because the pages give only centuries: 14 of 24 events are low confidence.
